nodes.name: install-audit.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a persistent SQLite-backed audit trail for capability install events, recording every install-relevant action (proposed, approved, installed, rejected, failed, uninstalled) with full provenance metadata. Exports the InstallAuditStore class and re-exports canonical audit vocabulary types from @waggle/shared to maintain backward compatibility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses type re-exports to alias @waggle/shared types (AuditRiskLevel, AuditApprovalClass, etc.) so downstream consumers importing from @waggle/core continue working unchanged after the type consolidation into @waggle/shared.

nodes.name: InstallAuditStore
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed store for capability installation audit events, implementing CRUD operations over the install_audit table including automatic schema migration for widened CHECK constraints and trust_source column gating.

nodes.name: install-audit-check-parity.test.ts
nodes.summary: Parity test that verifies the INSTALL_AUDIT_TABLE_SQL DDL in @waggle/core stays in sync with the mirror DDL in hive-mind-core/src/mind/schema.ts, preventing CHECK constraint drift between the monorepo implementation and the OSS substrate.

nodes.name: install-audit.test.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive integration test suite for InstallAuditStore covering record, query, filtering, schema migration, and edge cases across all audit vocabulary dimensions (actions, capability types, risk levels, trust sources, approval classes).
